description: USE THIS BEFORE ROUTING to correct a coordinate. Snaps a point to the vehicle entry and exit points on the real road network in South Korea. USAGE: the user will never ask for an "entry point". Call it yourself when a search_places result has NO rpx/rpy, then pass the corrected point to find_route. Display coordinates (dpx/dpy) sit at the building centre and cause detours and U-turns. IMPORTANT: skip it when rpx/rpy is already present — that coordinate is already on the road network, so a correction changes nothing. NOTE: the returned coordinates are numbers, not strings.

kind.description: Which entry points to return. "all" (default), "car" for vehicle entrances, "taxi-building" or "taxi-complex" for taxi pick-up and drop-off points.

posX.description: Longitude of the point to correct

posY.description: Latitude of the point to correct

showMap.description: Whether to render this result on the in-conversation map (default false). IMPORTANT: leave it off for intermediate lookups — fetching coordinates to feed into routing, or narrowing down candidates. Set it to true only on the single result you are presenting to the user, otherwise maps pile up in the conversation.

name: find_entry_points

entrypoints.description: Entry points snapped to the road network

angle.description: Approach bearing in degrees. 0 is due north, increasing clockwise

x.description: Longitude. Note this is a number, not a string

y.description: Latitude. Note this is a number, not a string

title: Snap a coordinate to road entry points in South Korea
